research.title: Boundary-Aware Adaptation for Low-Light Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Formulated whether boundary consistency could stabilize segmentation under illumination shifts; led development of an adaptation objective combining edge alignment and confidence filtering.
Evaluated the objective against entropy minimization baselines using controlled brightness perturbations, inspecting boundary errors and ablations of confidence thresholds.

research.title: Occlusion-Aware Representation Learning for Fine-Grained Recognition
bullets: Formulated how localized occlusion affects fine-grained recognition; led development of a patch consistency objective aligning visible regions across masked image views.
Extended the approach with visibility-weighted feature aggregation and evaluated generalization across occlusion patterns through component ablations and class-level error analysis.

Visibility-Weighted Feature Aggregation for Recognition Across Occlusion Patterns

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned image validation routines checking file readability, color modes, and metadata consistency before ingestion into an internal processing pipeline.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and documented validation failures to support debugging and maintenance of existing image processing utilities.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Image Classification Baselines
bullets: Implemented histogram of oriented gradients features with a linear classifier and a convolutional baseline for image classification using shared data splits.
Compared classification errors, training behavior, and sensitivity to image resizing while controlling preprocessing and documenting differences in class-level confusion patterns.

projects.title: Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented corner detection, patch descriptors, and robust homography estimation to align image pairs depicting planar scenes under viewpoint changes.
Compared descriptor normalization and matching thresholds using reprojection errors and visual overlays, examining failures caused by repetitive textures and limited overlap.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Denoising Methods
bullets: Implemented Gaussian filtering, nonlocal means, and a convolutional denoising baseline using clean images corrupted with synthetic noise for controlled comparisons.
Evaluated reconstruction quality and edge preservation across noise conditions, inspecting residual images to distinguish oversmoothing from retained noise artifacts.
